description_en: Creates an alert rule for a data integration task
description_zh: 创建数据集成报警规则
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-di-alarm-rule --metric-type Heartbeat --di-job-id 1 --name alartRule --trigger-conditions '[{"DdlReportTags":["AlterAddColumn"],"Severity":"Warning","Duration":10,"Threshold":10,"DdlTypes":["AlterAddColumn"]}]' --notification-settings '{"NotificationChannels":[{}],"InhibitionInterval":5,"NotificationReceivers":[{}],"MuteInterval":5}' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDIAlarmRule

parameters.help_en: The description of the alert rule
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The alert metric type. Valid values:
Heartbeat: task status alert.
FailoverCount: failover count alert.
Delay: task latency alert.
DdlReport: DDL notification.
ResourceUtilization: resource group utilization
parameters.help_zh:
告警指标类型，可选的枚举值：
Heartbeat（任务状态报警）
FailoverCount（failover次数报警）
Delay（任务延迟报警）
DdlReport（DDL通知）
ResourceUtilization（资源组使用率）
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the alert rule. By default, the alert rule is disabled
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则是否启用，默认不开启
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The task ID associated with the alert rule
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，是告警规则关联的任务ID
parameters.name: di_job_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert rule
parameters.name: name

fields.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用DdlTypes字段
fields.name: ddl_report_tags

fields.help_en: The list of DDL types that take effect. This parameter takes effect only when the metric type is DDL notification
fields.help_zh: 在DDL通知的时候才生效，需要生效的DDL列表
fields.name: ddl_types

fields.help_en: The time window for alert calculation. Unit: minutes
fields.help_zh: 告警计算时间区间，单位分钟
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en:
The severity level. Valid values:
Warning
Critical
fields.help_zh:
严重程度，可选的枚举值：
Warning
Critical
fields.name: severity

fields.help_en:
The alert threshold.
Task status alert: no threshold is required.
Failover count alert: the threshold is the number of failovers.
Task latency alert: the threshold is the latency duration. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh:
告警阈值。
任务状态报警：无需填写阈值。
failover次数报警：阈值为failover次数。
任务延迟报警：阈值为延迟时长，单位秒
fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The list of alert trigger conditions. Multiple conditions are supported
parameters.help_zh: 告警触发条件列表，支持多条件
parameters.name: trigger_conditions

fields.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用MuteInterval进行配置
fields.name: inhibition_interval

fields.help_en: The alert mute interval. Unit: minutes. Default value: 5
fields.help_zh: 告警抑制间隔时长，单位分钟，默认5分钟
fields.name: mute_interval

fields.help_en:
The notification channel. Valid values:
Mail: email.
Phone: phone call.
Sms: text message.
Ding: DingTalk
fields.help_zh:
通道，可选的枚举值：
Mail（邮件）
Phone（电话）
Sms（短信）
Ding（钉钉）
fields.name: channels

fields.help_en:
The severity level. Valid values:
Warning
Critical
fields.help_zh:
严重程度，可选的枚举值：
Warning
Critical
fields.name: severity

fields.help_en: The receiver type. Valid values: AliyunUid, DingToken, FeishuToken, and WebHookUrl
fields.name: receiver_type

fields.help_en:
The receiver values.
If the receiver type is AliyunUid, the value is the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
If the receiver type is DingToken, the value is the DingTalk token
fields.help_zh:
接收方取值。
当接收方类型为阿里云ID时，接收方取值为具体阿里云用户ID。
当接收方类型为钉钉token时，接收方取值为具体钉钉token值
fields.name: receiver_values

Id.description_en: The ID of the alert rule

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
